Save yourself money and do r wast it on this scam of an app. Maybe use rocket money instead.

Update*

This is their response to my above review:

“Thank you for your review! We would like to clarify that MonoBoost does not cancel subscriptions on your behalf, as cancellations must be completed directly with the service provider. Instead, the app provides the correct steps to help make the process faster and easier. We appreciate your feedback as we continue improving the app!💚"

So they self admit to such false advertising of their mediocre product. They are feckless, and proud of it. A dangerous combination in our post capitalistic hellscape.
